mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are termed inputs, which may mean the use of the services of land, labour, capital and organization in the process of production."
Factors of production are termed inputs, which may mean the use of the services of land, labour, capital and organization in the process of production.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a branch of Agricultural Economics and therefore you need to know something about Agricultural Economics."
Agricultural production economics is a branch of Agricultural Economics and therefore you need to know something about Agricultural Economics.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are derived from production functions in terms of the number of variable inputs used in the production process."
Agricultural cost functions are derived from production functions in terms of the number of variable inputs used in the production process.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a line or curve on which the slope of isoquant (MRTS) equals the slope of iso-cost line (price ratio)."
Expansion path is a line or curve on which the slope of isoquant (MRTS) equals the slope of iso-cost line (price ratio).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the costs of production which remains constant irrespective of change in output level."
Fixed costs are the costs of production which remains constant irrespective of change in output level.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ratio of Total Physical Product (TPP) to the quantity of input used in producing that amount of output."
The Average Physical Product (APP) is the ratio of Total Physical Product (TPP) to the quantity of input used in producing that amount of output.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the unavoidable costs which must be met every year."
The total overhead costs are the unavoidable costs which must be met every year.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as the transformation of one thing into another."
Production can be defined as the transformation of one thing into another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a convenient method of showing the two production functions in a single graph."
PPC is a convenient method of showing the two production functions in a single graph.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in calculating the true profit in accounting sense."
The operational costs are used in calculating the true profit in accounting sense.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the physical relationship between the output and inputs used in the production of the product b."
Production function is defined as the physical relationship between the output and inputs used in the production of the product b.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those costs which vary with output vi."
Total Variable Costs (TVC) are those costs which vary with output vi.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in the interregional and international trade to apportion goods to various countries."
Coefficient is used in the interregional and international trade to apportion goods to various countries.
